<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NuxtError } from '#app'
import type { InternalApi } from 'nitropack/types'

interface Item { id: string }

type Assert<T extends true> = T
// These assertions fail if a workaround removes module-owned route types.
type NewsletterRoutes =
  | '/api/newsletter/subscribe'
  | '/api/newsletter/resend-confirmation'
  | '/api/newsletter/confirm'
  | '/api/newsletter/unsubscribe'
  | '/api/newsletter/unsubscribe-all'
  | '/api/newsletter/preferences'
type AllRoutesPresent = Assert<NewsletterRoutes extends keyof InternalApi ? true : false>
type OnlyPost = Assert<keyof InternalApi[NewsletterRoutes] extends 'post' ? true : false>

const { data } = await useFetch<Item[], NuxtError, '/api/items'>(
  '/api/items', { default: () => [] }
)
const confirmation = $fetch<unknown, '/api/newsletter/confirm'>(
  '/api/newsletter/confirm', { method: 'POST', body: { token: 'example' } }
)
// @ts-expect-error the registered confirmation route only accepts POST
$fetch<unknown, '/api/newsletter/confirm'>('/api/newsletter/confirm', { method: 'GET' })
// @ts-expect-error the literal route generic rejects a different request path
useFetch<Item[], NuxtError, '/api/items'>('/api/other', { default: () => [] })
</script>

<template><div>{{ data.length }}</div></template>
